entries.title: v2026.11.0
entries.note: NanoClaw 2026.11.0 is the new stable release, so /update-nanoclaw on the default stable channel now offers it. 🦐 It covers everything since 2026.10.0 and was tested on the beta channel through nine pre-releases. Five changes you'll notice first: Each agent gets only the keys you give it. OneCLI moves to 1.45, where new agent groups get only their model key and other keys go to the groups you choose. OneCLI's database also gets its own password, which closes a critical security hole (see Security below). On OneCLI installs, both need a step from you. ( #4094 , #4439 ) Agents can create other agents from templates. Ask for one in chat, or pick one from ncl templates list or the public library. ( #4112 ) Cursor is an agent provider. Run /add-cursor , or pick Cursor in setup, and your agents run on Cursor's Agent SDK. ( #4107 ) Cards can show KPI fields, a table and charts. Agents put them

entries.title: v2026.11.0-rc.3
entries.note: NanoClaw 2026.11.0-rc.3 is the third release candidate of 2026.11.0: the build we expect to ship as stable unless testing finds a problem, so no more betas come before it. The November release takes the place of 2026.10.1, which never becomes a stable release; its two release candidates stay published, and everything they brought is in this entry. Installs on the beta channel get this release candidate; stable stays on 2026.10.0 until 2026.11.0 is published. Since 2026.11.0-rc.2, setup on Linux turns on systemd lingering without a polkit prompt, setup shows the provider image rebuild in its progress window, Codex sign-in no longer needs the Codex CLI installed, Slack agent DMs show suggested prompts, /add-onecli tells you when OneCLI's database still accepts the default password, and ~/.onecli can no longer be mounted into an agent container. entries.note: NanoClaw 2026.10.1-rc.2 is the second release candidate for 2026.10.1. Installs on the beta channel get this candidate; stable stays on 2026.10.0 until 2026.10.1 is published. entries.title: v2026.10.1-rc.1
entries.note: NanoClaw 2026.10.1-rc.1 is the first release candidate for 2026.10.1. Installs on the beta channel get this candidate; stable stays on 2026.10.0 until 2026.10.1 is published. It lets agents create other agents from templates, adds Cursor as an agent provider, and moves locally built agent images to Claude Code 2.1.296 with Claude Haiku 5.5. Setup waits for a slow first reply and says when that reply failed, approval cards appear in the thread you are waiting in, and fewer agent runs fail on Docker Desktop. Chat SDK channels move to 4.41.1, and Iron Proxy installs that signed Codex in with ChatGPT must sign in again, so check the section below before you update. ⚠️ Before you update [BREAKING] Chat SDK channels move to adapter 4.41.1, which fixes Telegram messages with links that were never delivered.
